title: Gateway content error
responsibility: Constructs the named error used for gateway content failures.

inputs.name: gatewayContentError.message
inputs.description: Explanation placed on the error as its message. Undefined leaves it empty, other values are converted to text, and a value that cannot be converted makes construction throw.

outputs.name: gatewayContentError
outputs.description: New Error with the supplied message and name GatewayContentError; the function returns it rather than throwing it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A message that cannot be converted to text, such as a Symbol or an object without toString or valueOf, throws from the Error constructor.

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Name an unsupported media message
examples.call: gatewayContentError('Unsupported media') // { name, message } => { name: 'GatewayContentError', message: 'Unsupported media' }

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Coerce null to the text null

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Leave the message empty for undefined

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Coerce a bigint to decimal text

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Use the text returned by an object's toString
examples.call: gatewayContentError({ toString: () => 'blocked upstream' }) // { name, message } => { name: 'GatewayContentError', message: 'blocked upstream' }

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Refuse a symbol message with a TypeError
examples.call: gatewayContentError(Symbol('gateway')) // throws { name: 'TypeError', message: 'Cannot convert a Symbol value to a string' }

value.name: TypeError
value.message: Cannot convert a Symbol value to a string

examples.subject: gatewayContentError
examples.name: Refuse a prototype-less object with a TypeError
examples.call: gatewayContentError(Object.create(null)) // throws { name: 'TypeError', message: 'Cannot convert object to primitive value' }

value.name: TypeError
value.message: Cannot convert object to primitive value
